current and foreseeable risk models can be useful for counseling and prevention, but given the challenge of achieving a high AUC, considerable effort should go into finding effective preventive and screening strategies with less adverse effects.

current and foreseeable breast cancer risk models are useful, but not sufficient, to inform clinical and public health decisions.
